svg.title: Homogenization
svg.desc: Three identical domains show a periodic two-phase medium with decreasing period epsilon equal to one, one half, and one quarter. An arrow epsilon to zero leads to a uniform effective medium Omega. The magnified reference cell Y is above Omega. The fill color of Omega is the area-weighted mean of inclusion and matrix colors.
svg.title: Homogenization diagram

ns2:Work.dc:title: Homogenization diagram
ns2:Work.dc:description: Three periodic coefficient fields with decreasing period, an epsilon-to-zero arrow, and a uniform effective medium below the magnified reference cell. The uniform color is the phase-area-weighted mean of the reference cell fill colors.
